test_cases.name: step1_state_space
test_cases.input: Formalize the Iris local core as a discrete dynamical system using the Chaos Architect protocol. Start with Step 1.
assertions: Defines 6-component state vector mapping Anise/Red Clover/AirSync/Iris/Horus/Ra
Constructs composite F = F6 o ... o F1

test_cases.name: step2_lyapunov
test_cases.input: Proceed to Step 2. Analyze local Lyapunov exponents for the Horus-Ra twin and error-cone dynamics.
assertions: Defines error-cone radius rho_cone(t) = rho0 * exp(lambda_Z^max * t)

test_cases.name: amusphere_environmental
test_cases.input: Render Horus and Ra as pure environmental fields similar to the Amusphere, not as playable characters.
assertions: Implements volumetric density advection driven by lambda_Z^max
Color maps blue for contraction and red for expansion

test_cases.name: verification_tests
test_cases.input: List the five visual verification tests for the local-layer Amusphere simulation.
assertions: Includes contraction test, period-2 birth, cascade accumulation, strange-attractor boundedness, and parameter-reset
